source_verification.title: Munc13-4 is essential for cytolytic granules fusion and is mutated in a form of familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (FHL3)
Recurrent tandem duplication of UNC13D in familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis type 3

second_answer_attack.resolution: PRF1/perforin deficiency is a major alternative cause of familial HLH, but perforin content is explicitly normal and granules polarize and dock normally. UNC13D/Munc13-4 deficiency instead blocks the priming step required before docked cytolytic granules fuse and release their contents.

blind_audit.rationale: Munc13-4 acts after lytic granules have polarized and docked at the plasma membrane, preparing them for exocytotic fusion. UNC13D deficiency therefore causes defective NK- and cytotoxic T-cell degranulation despite preserved perforin content and granule docking. Strongest alternative resolved: PRF1/perforin deficiency is a major alternative cause of familial HLH, but perforin content is explicitly normal and granules polarize and dock normally. UNC13D/Munc13-4 deficiency instead blocks the priming step required before docked cytolytic granules fuse and release their contents.
